prompt: On the Delivery step of checkout, typing in "Delivery instructions" makes the delivery options flicker, and the network panel shows a shipping-quote request for every key I press. The address hasn't changed, so quotes shouldn't be refetched. Fix it.

truth.cause: DeliveryStep passes destination as an inline object literal, and ShippingOptions' quote effect depends on that object, so every CheckoutFlow re-render (any keystroke) creates a new identity and re-runs the effect, aborting and re-sending the request.
truth.summary: Depend on the primitive fields (country, postalCode) in the effect, or memoise the destination object in the parent.
